_about.frame: Card frame, inches. Origin = front-bottom corner of the card body (front = the end 1.5 in from the tab). u along the card toward the rear (0-10), v up from the bottom edge of the body (0-5); the tab hangs below v=0 (u 1.43-7.92 on the CPU). Positions are seen on the component (silkscreen) side, which faces the right side of the box.
_about.parts: u,v = centre of the part footprint (for DIPs: centre of the pin grid). len = size along the long axis, wid = across; rot 0 = long axis along u, rot 90 = long axis along v. height = estimated top of the part above the board surface (height_conf est unless stated). pins = pin count (DIPs: verified on the copper for artwork parts).
_about.conf: artwork = measured on the 1:1 MITS X1 artwork scan (300 ppi) by fitting the pad grid to the copper; uncertainty about +/-0.02 in (scale 0.3 %, frame edge +/-0.01 in). photo = measured on a scaled photo/scan; uncertainty given per card (+/-0.08 to 0.12 in). est = estimate. datasheet/doc = from a document. Rev0-* parts are on the photographed Rev 0 boards but not on the X1 artwork.
_about.sources: Keys refer to research/sources/bibliography.md: MITS-ART-CPU, MITS-ART-1K, MFE-CPU-SCAN, MFE-1MCS-SCAN, MFE-4MCS-PHOTOS, MFE-SIO-PHOTOS, MFE-2SIO-PHOTOS, MITS-ADS-1975-76, SULLINS-CAT-2013, VCCA-GUIDE, PLANET-KAUFMAN. Facts and numbers only; no artwork or photo is kept in the repository.

edge_connector.source: SULLINS-CAT-2013 p.62-63 (".125 contact centers, .431 insulator height", 50/100 positions); MITS facts from notes-boards-and-backplane.md
edge_connector.note: Modern equivalent of the MITS 100-pin connector (manufacturer of the 1975 part unknown; green bodies in photos). The equivalent matches the MITS expander-board drawing: ear-hole spacing 6.795 in vs 6.80 in measured, row spacing 0.140 in (narrow dip) vs 0.14-0.15 in.

card_slot_length_B.note: inside length of the card slot (= the 6.375 in tab), +/-0.008

ear_hole_spacing_D.note: mounting hole centres, +/-0.010; MITS drawing p.65 gives 6.80

insertion_depth.note: card slot depth from the top of the insulator

ear_step.note: height of the ear/top step dimension shown on the drawing (reading of the drawing; check)

mounting_hole_dia.note: clearance hole (H mounting style); MITS used 4-40 x 5/8 in screws through the ears

row_spacing.note: narrow dip-solder tails (RT); HJ-S100BUS gives 0.140 for MITS

tail_length.note: RT dip-solder tail, 0.140 x 0.200 option; tails 0.043 in holes

card_slot_width.note: not given; use ~0.07 in (IEEE 696 guide slot 0.071-0.080)

card_seat_height_est.note: card body bottom edge (v=0) above the backplane top = standoff 0.025 + insulator 0.431 - insertion depth 0.265 + tab depth 0.3 (about 0.49); IEEE 696 gives no number. Use 0.45-0.5

card_guide.source: VCCA-GUIDE (owner measurements of an original blue MITS guide, mm, "may not be 100% accurate"); PLANET-KAUFMAN STL for comparison
card_guide.note: Original guide: moulded blue nylon post (very early: natural nylon), one at each end of each slot, slot facing the card; 2 holes in the base (#6-32 x 3/8 in screws from below, hole pair 0.31 in apart per the expander drawing). The two faces are not symmetrical.

base_footprint_along_card.note: base depth in the direction of the card (2 screw holes in this direction)

width_across_lower.note: lower 66.5 mm (2.62 in) of the post

width_across_upper.note: upper part above a step at 66.5 mm; step 5.75 / 5.15 mm per side (asymmetric)

depth_at_top.note: side view tapers from the 16.75 mm base to 7.5 mm at the top

slot_section.note: cross-section drawing E: channel 7.85 mm deep overall, 2.25 mm and 3 mm steps, walls 2.85 / 2.15 mm, 7 mm wide - read from an annotated photo, treat as approximate

top_notch.note: notch at the top about 3.5-4 mm wide; a 2.5 mm feature 22 mm below the top

base_block_height.note: stepped base block 16 mm tall with a 2.5 mm step

kaufman_stl.note: agrees with the measurements within 0.3 mm
